instruction.name: xvssrlni.b.h
instruction.description: Logical right shift the unsigned 16-bit elements in `a` and `b` by `imm`, saturate the result to signed 8-bit, write the 8-bit result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
